purpose: Shows the kinds and circles a person has for the holder, and lets the holder add one with "+ Relation".
namedChanges: the imports are the units': `termOrigin` from `term-origin`; `HELD_NOTES_STALE_MS`, `heldClaimsKey`, `mergeClaim`, `runSerial`, `listHeldClaimsAbout`, `readHeldClaimDoc` and the type `HeldClaimDoc` from `held-notes`; `useAdderCard` from `adder-card`; `sameIri` from `stated-by`; the catalogue reads, `readOwnEntryName`, `readOwnKinds`, `USER_VOCAB_KEY`, `readHeaderVocab` from `contact-kind-catalogue`; the model functions and types from `contact-kind-model`; the tie functions and the types `KindVault`, `TieFound` from `kind-relation`; `readRelations`, `relationsKey`, `uriTail`, `readRelationDoc` from `lws-relations`; `NotSignedInError` from `lws-session-bridge`; `annotationsFit` from `contact-annotation`; `createResource`, `deleteResource`, `getResource`, `FactValue` from `vault-resources`; `attributeSpelling`, `typeSpelling` from `term-slots`; `registerCardPartTypes` from `lws-vault-sets`
